headline: Zelda: Breath of the Wild
title: Zelda Breath of the Wild Facts | Game of the Year 2017 | Classic Games
video_script: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild came out in March twenty seventeen for Wii U and Nintendo Switch, developed and published by Nintendo. It won Game of the Year at The Game Awards twenty seventeen, along with Best Game Direction and Best Action Adventure Game. Hidemaro Fujibayashi directed it. Did you climb everything? Comment below!
